name: Mrs. Park's Classic Noodle Pack
description: The ubiquitous instant noodle pack of GLMZ. Just add hot water, wait three minutes, and you have something that tastes close enough to real food that you stop thinking about the difference.
flavor_profile: Salty, MSG-rich broth with a subtle sesame undertone, chewy synth-wheat noodles that hold texture surprisingly well
slogan: Like Mom made. If Mom had a factory.
cultural_context: Mrs. Park is a real person — Sun-Hi Park, who started selling noodles from a the Gray Zone corridor cart in 2071. The brand is now a subsidiary of Kanto-Pacific Nutrition but she still appears on every package. Everyone in the Gray Zone has eaten these. They are comfort food at the bottom of the world.
story_hooks: Sun-Hi Park is still alive, living in Tier 2, and deeply unhappy with what Kanto-Pacific has done to her recipe — she's looking for someone to help her reclaim her brand.
A contaminated batch of Mrs. Park's caused a minor illness cluster in the Gray Zone Block 7 — coincidence or sabotage?
